modules.responsibility: start the service, run bounded workflow checks, and open the local outbox terminal
entities, validation, state transitions, and metrics
orchestrate formulas, vessels, runs, observations, and the transactional outbox
persist and load revisioned JSON snapshots atomically and recover interrupted claims
route HTTP requests and map protocol errors
provide a read-only on-machine terminal for the local outbox
exercise public HTTP workflows with real requests

workflows.name: Create, configure, approve, and read a formula
steps: create a draft formula with validated target values
set the process step list in one operation
workflows.success: returns the approved formula with version 3
workflows.failure: returns a stable validation, duplicate, or state error without partial writes
workflows.verification: the check issues real HTTP requests and inspects success and failure responses

workflows.name: Register a vessel and advance a reserved run to fermentation
steps: create a planned run against an approved formula
start fermentation and read the combined state
workflows.success: returns an in-use vessel and a fermenting run
workflows.failure: returns a stable capacity, availability, duplicate, or revision conflict
workflows.verification: the check issues real HTTP requests, verifies rejection behavior, and reads the aggregate

workflows.name: Append observations, start conditioning, and complete a run
steps: append ordered gravity and temperature observations
complete the run and compute attenuation and estimated alcohol
read the completed run and released vessel state
workflows.success: returns computed metrics and a vessel in cleaning state
workflows.failure: returns a stable range, sequence, time, state, or count error
workflows.verification: the check issues real HTTP requests and rejects malformed observations

workflows.name: Produce, claim, fail, and recover local duty notifications
steps: approve a formula, start fermentation, record a hot observation, and finish cleaning
list and filter messages by recipient, run, type, and state
claim one message exclusively and reject duplicate claims
fail the claim, reclaim it, and complete it with the claim token
restart on the same snapshot and verify interrupted claims requeue without loss or duplication
read the outbox from the on-machine command-line terminal
workflows.success: each business fact produces exactly one durable message that one terminal handles
workflows.failure: duplicate claims, wrong tokens, and replayed facts are rejected without duplicate messages
workflows.verification: the check issues real HTTP requests, reopens the durable data directory, and drives the local terminal
